technicalCriterionList.description: To Qualify for award of this contract the tenderer, as a prime contractor, should have in his name Satisfactorily completed at least Similar Nature of Work /Pavement Concrete Work Costing not less than Rs 210.75 Lakhs. The work should have been commenced and completed in any year during the last five financial years (i.e from 01-04-2021 till date of submission) i.e the work must have commenced on or after 01-04-2021 and completed till the date of submission of tender. Note: The work done certificate shall clearly mention the date of commencement & date of completion. Scanned copy of the Work done Completion Certificate, Certified by an Officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer in case of works done in Govt/Public Sector under taking Only.

To Qualify for award of this contract the Tenderer Executed in any one Financial year during the last 5 years (i.e, during the years years 2021-22 , 2022-23 , 2023-24 2024-25 & 2025-26 the following minimum quantities of work in any of the Government / Public Sector Undertaking. To Qualify for award of this contract the Tenderer, as a prime contractor, should have in his name Executed in any one financial year during last five years i.e. years 2021-22 , 2022-23 , 2023-24 ,2024-25 & 2025-26 the quantities of works mentioned below1.Pavment Concrete M30 and above 1136.00 cum2. TMT/Mild Reinforcement Steel 58.90 Tonne3. RCC M20and above 192.00Cum4. Embankment 5200.00Cum5. Dry Lean Concrete(DLC) /Wet Mix macadam 1704.00Cum Scanned copy of the Work done Certificate, Certified by an Officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer in case of works done in Govt. Out of the total quantity executed in a single work, only the quantities executed in a particular financial year will be considered for evaluation.

To Qualify for award of this contract the tenderer in his name should have, in the last five financial years ( i.e. during the years 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26) achieved in at least two financial years a minimum average financial turnover of Rs 843.02 Lakhs (in all classes of civil engineering construction works only ).Scanned copy of audited profit / loss statement of at least two financial years in which minimum financial turnover of Rs. 843.02 Lakhs. is achieved . (Certified by Chartered Accountant along with UDIN and membership number only. Statement issued by others will not qualify for eligibility).

To Qualify for award of this contract the assessed available tender capacity of the tenderer should be more than the amount put to tender. Note: The bid capacity of the tenderer is calculated based on the formula. Assessed Available Tender Capacity ( (Ax N x 1.5) B) WhereA Maximum value of Civil Engineering works, (updated to the financial year of Tender invited), executed in any one year during the last five years. (Completed as well as works in progress).B Value at price level (updated to the financial year of tender invited) of existing commitments and ongoing works to be completed during the next two years.N Number of years prescribed for completion of the work for which tender is invited.1.5 Multiplying factor for assessing the available tender capacity for works costing above Rs.100.00Lakhs.The bidder/Contractor must submit details of existing commitments and on going works to be completed in the Prescribed format only (Annexure - B) Details of the works which have been completed and final bill is yet to be settled should also be provided .In case the bidder does not have any existing commitments, the same should be indicated as NIL in the prescribed format duly signed by the bidder Details submitted in any other format or other format or submission of document in which the bidder himself has calculated the bid capacity will not be considered and will not qualify for eligibility.

Liquid assets and or availability of credit facilities of not less than Rs. 126.45 Lakhs (credit lines /letters of credit /certificates from Banks) for meeting the fund requirement etc.Scanned Copy of the Letter of Credit/From any nationalized Bank /Schedule bank (excluding Co-operative banks), clearly specifying name of the work (as per the prescribed format) (Annexure-A) LOC Note :The certificate should contains Name of the work, and address to the Executive Engineer, KSRTC, CE Division, Tumakuru with Valid dates and amount etc.
